## Overview

Single-file Three.js arcade flight sim served by Bun. The canonical game file is `flight-sim3.html` at the project root. Physics, HUD, combat, multiplayer, and settings all live in that one file. Multiple AI agents (Claude, Codex/GPT-5.5, OpenClaw) collaborate on this workspace through the CodeSurf canvas peer protocol.

## Durable Facts

### Project layout

- `flight-sim3.html` — main game (~12 000 lines, Three.js, all logic inline)
- `plane-select.html` / `index.html` — plane selection / landing page
- `plane-tweaks.json` — per-model tuning overrides loaded at runtime
- `multiplayer-server.mjs` — WebSocket room server
- `tweaks-server.mjs` — static web server (Bun, default port 8766)
- `autopilot.mjs` — autopilot / headless test-driver helper

- `progress.md` — dated log of all passes and verification results

### Running the project

- `bun start` — launches web server + multiplayer server concurrently
- Port 8766 — HTTP static + WebSocket room (`ws://localhost:8766`)
- Ports 8765 and 3000 — observed in live sessions; purposes unconfirmed
- Do not restart the live server between agent sessions unless explicitly asked

### Settings persistence

- Active localStorage key: `gfx-settings-v5`
- Legacy keys `v2/v3/v4` cleared automatically on load and on settings reset
- Default profile: `trainer` flight + `casual` control preset
- `RESET SETTINGS` button in the Options panel

## Active Subsystem Behaviour

### Camera (fixed 2026-05-03, ~line 1829)

- FOV narrowed to 60–68° raw lens range (was ~76–99° dynamic; caused fisheye edge stretch)
- Aspect-corrected vertical FOV: `2 * Math.atan(Math.tan(fov/2) / aspect)`
- Chase camera moved slightly farther back to reframe at narrower FOV
- Radial motion-blur edge sampling reduced; blur UV reads clamped

### Physics & controls

- Fixed-step physics, arcade rate-command pitch/roll/yaw, angular velocity caps
- Sideslip damping, turn energy bleed, high-speed control falloff
- Gamepad: Xbox/PlayStation/generic, trigger-axis fallback, double-deadzone fix
- `advanceTime()` / `window.__ap` bridge; `__ap.setGamepad()` / `clearGamepad()` for tests

### Multiplayer race mode

- `N` key or HUD button starts shared countdown; remote clients auto-adopt
- Left-side HUD: timer, room size, gate progress, best time, leaderboard
- Practice-course gate scoring feeds race progress and finish timing

### Telemetry bridge

- `window.__ap.telemetry()` returns multiplayer/traffic/combat/flight data (~line 11970+)
- `render_game_to_text` for headless state snapshots

## Known Bugs (unfixed as of 2026-05-03)

- **Startup free kill** — `combat_kills: 1` before any player input; runway traffic intersects parked player and collision fires at zero speed
- **Reticle gated behind `mouseFlight`** — defaults `false`; keyboard players get no gunsight despite combat being keyboard-first
- **Reticle follows mouse NDC, not gun-line** — no spring/lag, not from actual muzzle trajectory
- **Resize/fullscreen corrupts mouse-flight target** — resize handler clamps normalised values as pixels
